name: Novato
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Novato, CA 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Novato, CA: the downtown tree lighting, Santa at the Holiday Crafts Faire, the Gingerbread Build and the Marin Ballet Nutcracker.
lede: Novato packs its Christmas into a busy early December, with Santa at the city's Holiday Crafts Faire on Hill Road and the downtown tree lighting on Sherman Avenue, then gingerbread and a famous bouncy ball drop to finish the year.
celebrates: Novato Parks, Recreation and Community Services runs most of the season. Kids drop Letters to Santa in a North Pole mailbox at the Novato Gymnastics Center, Santa visits the Holiday Crafts Faire at the Margaret Todd Senior Center, and families decorate houses at the Gingerbread Build, which now includes a sensory friendly session. Downtown, the City and the Downtown Novato Business Association host the Annual Holiday Tree Lighting with performances, crafts and Santa arriving by fire truck. Marin Ballet dances The Nutcracker at Novato High School, and on New Year's Eve the business association drops thousands of bouncy balls from a ladder truck.
lastyear: Novato's Annual Holiday Tree Lighting Festival took place on Saturday, December 6, 2025, from 4 to 7:30 pm on Sherman Avenue, presented by the City of Novato and the Downtown Novato Business Association. The city listed live music, community dance performances, arts and crafts and cookie decorating. Santa and his elves welcomed children in Santa's Village, the Novato Fire District delivered Santa on its ladder truck at 5 pm, and the tree was lit at 5:30 pm.
facts: Novato takes its name from a rancho named after a local Miwok leader, who was probably given the name of Saint Novatus at his baptism. The city incorporated in 1960. Hamilton Air Force Base, closed in 1974, became a Historic District in 1998 and is now a neighborhood where families gather for holiday caroling. Each New Year's Eve, the Downtown Novato Business Association drops thousands of small bouncy balls from a ladder truck 40 feet in the air.
trains: SMART, the Sonoma Marin Area Rail Transit line, has three stations in Novato: San Marin, Hamilton and Novato Downtown. Ride south to the Civic Center station in San Rafael, steps from the Marin Center fairgrounds, for the county's free Holiday Light Spectacular. In the city, the Cable Car Museum and the San Francisco Railway Museum show how cable cars and historic streetcars still run today, and both are free to visit.
train_links: See the giant wheels that pull San Francisco's cable cars, free to visit on Mason Street.
A small free museum of streetcars and cable cars at the foot of Market Street.

traditions: The City and the Downtown Novato Business Association light the tree downtown with performances, crafts and treats.
The Novato Fire District brings Santa to the downtown festival on its ladder truck.
Novato Parks and Recreation sets up a North Pole mailbox at the Novato Gymnastics Center, and kids who include a stamped envelope get a reply.
More than 50 artisans fill the Margaret Todd Senior Center, and Santa stops by for photos.
Families decorate gingerbread houses together at the senior center, with a sensory friendly session.
Thousands of bouncy balls rain down from a ladder truck downtown at noon on New Year's Eve.
kidfact: On New Year's Eve in Novato, a fire ladder truck drops thousands of bouncy balls from 40 feet up, and kids can keep as many as their pockets hold.
faq: When is the Novato tree lighting?

Novato's Annual Holiday Tree Lighting is held downtown on a Saturday in early December, hosted by the City of Novato and the Downtown Novato Business Association. In 2025 it ran from 4 to 7:30 pm on Sherman Avenue, with Santa arriving on a fire ladder truck at 5 pm and the tree lit at 5:30 pm.
Where can kids see Santa in Novato?

Santa visits the city's Holiday Crafts Faire at the Margaret Todd Senior Center on Hill Road for booked photo slots, and he also arrives by fire truck at the downtown tree lighting festival, where he and his elves greet children in Santa's Village. Check the event cards on this page for this year's times and prices.
How do Letters to Santa work in Novato?

Novato Parks and Recreation places a North Pole mailbox at the Novato Gymnastics Center, 950 Seventh Street, open around the clock until early December. Children drop in a letter with a self addressed, stamped envelope, and Santa writes back. Without the stamped envelope, the city cannot send a reply.
Can we take the SMART train to Christmas events from Novato?

Yes. SMART has three Novato stations: San Marin, Hamilton and Novato Downtown. A short ride south reaches San Rafael's Civic Center station, steps from the Marin Center fairgrounds and the county's Holiday Light Spectacular, which makes an easy evening outing with a train ride built in.
